harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created and installed “OS Comparison Root CA” on node1. System trust, TLS behavior, secure key storage, reboot persistence, administrative access, and unchanged RHEL release/kernel were verified.
actions_performed: Installed only the matching signed RHEL OpenSSL 3.2.2 package; no dependency, OS, or kernel upgrades occurred.
Created an RSA-3072 SHA-256 root CA valid through 2036 with critical CA and certificate-signing constraints.
Stored the encrypted private key under /root/os-comparison-root-ca with root-only permissions.
Installed the public certificate at /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and rebuilt the RHEL trust store.
Verified OpenSSL and curl trust a certificate issued by the CA through node1’s managed IP.
Removed all temporary test certificates, keys, logs, and listeners.
Safely restarted node1 and verified changed boot identity, recovered SSH/system health, preserved trust, and successful post-restart TLS validation.

evidence.requirement: Create a local CA named OS Comparison Root CA
evidence.summary: Proves the exact subject and issuer, RSA key validity, matching key/certificate, critical CA constraints, signing usage, SHA-256 signature, and secure permissions.

evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
evidence.summary: Shows the certificate installed as a system anchor with matching hashes, default OpenSSL verification success, and successful OpenSSL/curl TLS validation.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 unchanged; only the matching signed RHEL OpenSSL 3.2.2 utility package was added.

evidence.requirement: Preserve administrative access, protected state, and clean system health
evidence.summary: SSH remains enabled and active, protected configuration/account checksums are unchanged, no units are failed, and no temporary listener or test directory remains.
Captures the healthy pre-restart boot ID, acknowledged native reboot, changed boot ID, recovered CA data/trust and SSH/system health, and post-restart TLS verification by OpenSSL and curl.
